# Aira Ynte — Technical Profile & Portfolio Digest

> Software Engineer & System Architect specializing in full-stack web applications, hardware-firmware integration, Web3 settlement rails, and AI copilots. Computer Engineering '26, Metro Manila.

## Profile Summary
Aira Ynte (@Aera0908) is a software engineer and computer engineering candidate operating at the intersection of hardware, web systems, artificial intelligence, and decentralized financial rails. Experience spans building open-finance treasury software on Layer 2 EVM networks, custom ESP32-S3 biometrics smartwatches with machine-learning pose estimation, browser-based EDA tools for VLSI circuit design, and interactive 3D WebGL user experiences.

## Key Case Studies & Technical Work

### 1. FEHUVIA — Web3 B2B Treasury Workstation (2026)
- **Role**: Lead Web3 & Full-Stack Developer
- **Stack**: React 19, Vite, Solidity, Morph L2, Ethers.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, OpenAI GPT-4o RAG
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/fehuvia/
- **Overview**: Open-finance treasury workstation cutting settlement times to under 2 seconds on Morph L2 via custom Solidity smart contracts (`B2BSettlement.sol`), dual-state PostgreSQL auditing, AI OCR invoice parsing, and a GPT-4o RAG cashflow analytics engine.

### 2. AEROVIT — Hybrid Fitness Ecosystem & Smartwatch (2024 — 2026)
- **Award**: Awarded Best Thesis
- **Role**: Lead Developer & Embedded Systems Architect
- **Stack**: ESP32-S3, BLE 5.0, Flutter, MediaPipe BlazePose, ChromaDB RAG, Ethereum Sepolia ERC-20, Firebase
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/aerovit/
- **Overview**: Hybrid fitness system pairing a custom ESP32-S3 biometrics smartwatch with a 33-landmark MediaPipe pose tracking pipeline, Flame 2D gamified dungeon RPG, ChromaDB RAG AI coaching, and ERC-20 reward settlements on Sepolia.

### 3. STICKOUT — Browser EDA Tool for VLSI Stick Diagrams (2026)
- **Role**: Creator & Lead Frontend Engineer
- **Stack**: React 19, Vite 8, HTML5 Canvas 2D, TypeScript
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/stickout/
- **Overview**: Browser-based EDA CAD application featuring an infinite 2D viewport (0.1×–5× zoom), automatic wire crossover bridging, LaTeX label rendering, 50-level undo/redo, and design-rule verification.

### 4. EMG Interface Controller — Embedded Biosignal Controller
- **Role**: Embedded Systems Developer & Hardware Designer
- **Stack**: ESP32-S3, C/C++, DSP (500 Hz sampling), Python, KiCad PCB, Fusion 360
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/emg-controller/
- **Overview**: Real-time EMG signal processing on ESP32-S3 with a multi-stage DSP envelope pipeline, real-time Python GUI telemetry, and a muscle-activation game input bridge.

### 5. The Safehouse — Interactive 3D WebGL Showcase (2025 — Present)
- **Role**: Frontend & 3D Web Developer
- **Stack**: Next.js, React Three Fiber, Three.js, GSAP, Lenis, Rive
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/safehouse/
- **Overview**: 3D scroll-driven narrative journey with procedural terrain, ember particle physics, and accessibility-first motion reduction options.

### 6. Familiar — Gamified Computer Vision Focus Companion (2026)
- **Role**: Solo Developer & Product Designer
- **Stack**: Flutter, Google ML Kit, Flame 2D, Isar, Firebase
- **Url**: https://aera0908.github.io/vault/archive/familiar/
- **Overview**: Offline-first mobile companion using front-camera computer vision for real-time distraction detection and creature growth mechanics during focus sessions.
